Mesh Node Settings

Set the shared pairing secret used by Mesh Fleet on the computer that will connect to this node. Enter the same secret in that computer’s Mesh Fleet settings.

Telemetry requests are rejected until a token is configured.
Allow incoming TCP connections on this port in the machine’s firewall.
Advertise this sender with mDNS so Mesh Fleet can find it.
Changing the port or LAN discovery setting requires restarting this plugin.
